description: This file serves as an index for database-related functionalities in a Node.js project. It exports model definitions, establishes a connection to a MongoDB database via an imported connectDB function, and includes an initialization function for setting up the database connection. Additionally, it contains a script to connect to the database if the file is executed directly, with logging for success or failure.

methods.name: initDatabase()
methods.description: Initializes and returns an active MongoDB connection. Intended as an external API for consumers.
